text:
nina: heads up — from 07:45 UTC we're seeing a spike of egress mTLS failures from svc=region-eu -> model-serving-1. root cause looks like KMS unwrap denied on certchain. anyone touched RBAC/kms today?
raj: yup I pushed the RBAC tightening for keystore-access at 07:30. didn't expect unwrap denies though. logs?
kyle: saw the same. metrics show KMS 429s and a throttling burst after a config rollback attempt.
nina: sample error from model-serving-1 logs:
```
2026-03-21T07:45:12Z ERROR tls: handshake failed: tls: unexpected message
2026-03-21T07:45:12Z ERROR kms: unwrap failed: AccessDenied; principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rotator denied by keystore-policy
```
raj: ^ that's the AccessDenied path. policy change removed kms:Decrypt for the rotator role by accident.
sre-oncall: ops alert triggered: service=model-serving-1 5xx rate +130% :rotating_light:
ops-bot: incident created: INC-20260321-42 assigned to sre-oncall
kyle: temporary mitigation — we can add a narrow exception for `arn:role/rotator` with kms:Decrypt on keystore alias, then audit the grant.
nina: can we do that without breaking least privilege? need to document in audit logs and a followup PR to tighten after rotation completes.
raj: will submit a scoped IAM change and ping @audit-bot to record justification + ticket link.
audit-bot: recorded: change-request CR-7893 by raj; reason="restore rotator decrypt to avoid mTLS handshake failures"; tags=[security,ml-inference]
nina: thanks. after grant applied, please monitor TLS handshake success and KMS 429s for 10m. prefer canary to just global.
kyle: applied scoped grant to eu rotator role on keystore alias, canary=10% traffic for 5m
sre-oncall: seeing handshake error drop back to baseline, 1m in :thumbsup:
raj: will follow with PR to revert to short-lived key material and adjust rotator schedule so it doesn't overlap other maintenance windows.
nina: create postmortem note and include runbook update: if KMS Unwrap AccessDenied -> check recent RBAC commits + rotator policy
kyle: adding logs to alert docs and short playbook snippet.
nina: great. closing thread once postmortem and audit ticket linked. thx :heart:
